What a reset does (master stays on)
• Every app on the device, live and remembered (closed): own level 100 %, then scaled by master at once (Volume mixer shows master's amount).
• Apps that set their own volume: the mark is cleared and they are reset too; if they fight again, the existing rule marks them again.
• Stale master mutes are cleared when master is not muted; master's level and mute never change. The device stays held near the top.
• Never louder than master: each app ends at master's amount, at most. No "pause scaling" state (on a device that ignores volume it would be full blast).
• Undo puts back each app's previous own level and mark (tray only), until the next volume change or 10 min.
